in_arabic.name: شامون
in_arabic.meaning: شامون اسم مشتق از زبان آرامی، معنای آن پنهان شده است
in_arabic.long_meaning: شامون یک نام خاص است که ریشه‌های آن به زبان آرامی برمی‌گردد. این نام در فرهنگ‌های مختلف اسلامی و عربی مورد استفاده قرار می‌گیرد. معنای آن به عنوان 'پنهان شده' یا 'مخفی' است، که ممکن است به مفاهیم روحانی و عرفانی مرتبط باشد. در برخی از منابع، شامون به عنوان یکی از نام‌های حضرت موسی یا سایر انبیاء ذکر شده است.

in_urdu.name: شامون
in_urdu.meaning: شامون کا مطلب مخفی یا پوشیدہ ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: شامون ایک نام ہے جو آرامی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب 'مخفی' یا 'پوشیدہ' ہوتا ہے، جو اسلامی اور عربی ثقافتوں میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام ممکن ہے کہ حضرت موسی یا دیگر انبیاء کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہو، جو روحانی اور عرفانی مفاهیم سے منسلک ہو۔

in_hindi.name: शामून
in_hindi.meaning: शामून का अर्थ छुपा हुआ या गुप्त होता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: शामून एक नाम है जो अरामी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ 'छुपा हुआ' या 'गुप्त' होता है, जो भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम संभवतः हज़रत मूसा या अन्य पैगंबरों के नामों में से एक है, जो आध्यात्मिक और रहस्यमय अवधारणाओं से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: شامون
in_pashto.meaning: شامون د پټ یا چپه خوی معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: شامون یو نوم دی چی د ارامی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. ددی نوم مطلب 'پټ' یا 'چپه' دی، چی د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو کړاو کې استعمال کیږي. دا نوم ممکنه ده چی د حضرت موسی یا نورو پیغمبرانو د نومونو څخه یو وي، چی د روحاني او عرفاني مفاهیمو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.long_meaning: Shamoon is a name derived from Aramaic roots, signifying 'hidden' or 'concealed'. It is used in various Islamic and Arabic cultures. The name may relate to spiritual and mystical concepts, possibly connecting to figures like Prophet Moses. Its usage spans across different Muslim communities globally.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shamoon holds a deep connection to the lunar cycle and celebrates the beauty and rhythms of the natural world according to the Islamic culture. It's a name that embodies the interconnectedness between humanity and the cosmos, and can be found in various Islamic cultures, particularly those that place great emphasis on the significance of the lunar calendar.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the moon represents the Divine Light that illuminates our path and guides us through the darkness. It symbolizes the constant changing aspects of life, reminding us of the cyclical nature of existence and the importance of embracing change. The name Shamoon serves as a reminder of the Divine Illumination that shines upon us, guiding us towards our spiritual goals and helping us to navigate the complexity of life.

historical_references.reference: Al-Tabari, Ibn Ja'far Muhammad ibn Jarir. The History of Al-Tabari, Vol. VII: The Caliphate of Mu'awiya I. SUNY Press, 1990.
historical_references.context: During the reign of Mu'awiya I, the Umayyad caliph, there was a famous preacher named Shamoon al-Aswad (Black Shamoon). He was known for his eloquence and was a major figure in the opposition to Mu'awiya. However, he eventually supported Mu'awiya after a series of events, including a vision from the Prophet Muhammad in a dream.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir, Ibn Al-Kathir. The life of the Prophet Muhammad. Al-Firdous Ltd, 2000. The name Shamoon carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: One of the earliest references to the name Shamoon is found in relation to a man who was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad named Shamoon ibn Abjar. He was one of the ten companions who were given the title 'The Ten Promised Paradise'. He was known for his generosity and piety.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Shamoon holds significant importance in Islamic mythology, folklore, and art. Shamoon is often depicted as a powerful jinn (supernatural being) in Islamic folklore and mythology. This character has gained popularity in modern times, particularly on social media platforms such as Twitter and Instagram, where it is often mentioned in conversations and stories. On art platforms like DeviantArt, Shamoon is a popular subject for artists, with many creating intricate illustrations and paintings of this legendary figure. The general trend is to portray Shamoon as a powerful and wise jinn, often associated with magic, knowledge, and the natural world.
